title: Contract-First Epistemology: Full Course Syllabus and Audit Receipt
source_native_claims: Purpose (source-stated): a compact audit view of the full twenty-eight-week teaching structure, designed to be read before the main course body is assessed; it treats the course itself as an evaluable object (Receipt ID CFE.SYLLABUS-RECEIPT.v1.0).

Scope (source-stated): front matter, course body, back matter, Teaching Kit, templates, ledgers, readiness checks, rubrics, and final transmission instruments. Out of scope: empirical pilot results, live cohort performance, institutional approval, instructor-specific adaptations, and domain-specific course variants.
Non-goal (source-stated): do not require students to master the full GCD / UMCP mathematical corpus before they can operate the basic evaluative discipline.
